definitions.explanation: A printed publication containing news, articles, and advertisements.

examples.japanese: {新聞|しんぶん}に{載|の}っていた。
{毎朝|まいあさ}{新聞|しんぶん}を{読|よ}みます。
examples.english: I read the newspaper every morning.

examples.japanese: {新聞|しんぶん}を{取|と}っていますか。
examples.english: Do you subscribe to a newspaper?

examples.japanese: {新聞|しんぶん}{配達|はいたつ}のアルバイトは{毎朝|まいあさ}{早|はや}く{起|お}きなければならない。
examples.english: A newspaper delivery part-time job requires waking up early every morning.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}はインターネットで{新聞|しんぶん}を{読|よ}む{人|ひと}が{増|ふ}えて、{紙|かみ}の{新聞|しんぶん}を{取|と}る{家|いえ}が{減|へ}っている。
examples.english: Recently, more people are reading newspapers online, and fewer households are subscribing to paper newspapers.

notes:
{新聞|しんぶん} refers to newspapers, both print and digital editions.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {新聞|しんぶん}を{読|よ}む: to read the newspaper
- {新聞|しんぶん}を{取|と}る: to subscribe to a newspaper
- {新聞|しんぶん}に{載|の}る: to appear in the newspaper

RELATED TERMS:
- {新聞社|しんぶんしゃ}: newspaper company
- {新聞|しんぶん}{記事|きじ}: newspaper article
- {新聞|しんぶん}{配達|はいたつ}: newspaper delivery
- {新聞|しんぶん}{記者|きしゃ}: newspaper reporter

EDITIONS:
- {朝刊|ちょうかん}: morning edition
- {夕刊|ゆうかん}: evening edition

CULTURAL NOTE:
Major Japanese newspapers include {朝日|あさひ}{新聞|しんぶん}, {読売|よみうり}{新聞|しんぶん}, and {毎日|まいにち}{新聞|しんぶん}.
